newsitem.title: ERITREA: Sudanese rebels appeal for aid for captured areas.
newsitem.headline: Sudanese rebels appeal for aid for captured areas.

text.p: The main Sudanese rebel movement declared three areas in eastern Sudan it captured this month from the government as disaster areas and appealed for foreign aid.

The Sudan People's Liberation Movement and its humanitarian wing declared Kurmuk, Gazan and Maban counties disaster areas because of what they said was looting by retreating Sudanese government troops.
"The people of the three counties, which are 600,000, urgently require food, medicine, blankets, seeds and tools for the next agricultural season," they said in a statement.
"There is also a continuous aerial bombardment of civilian villages," they added.
"An appeal goes out to the international community and the relief assistance organisations to assist the three counties through the Sudan Relief and Rehabilitation Association," it added.
Eritrea and Ethiopia both deny Khartoum's accusations that their troops are fighting alongside the rebels in the east.
